result.summary: Found 3 issues: an untranslated placeholder key string, a cut-off restaurant card at the edge of the screen, and inconsistent heart icon styling.

issues.description: The section title displays a raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text like 'Popular near you'
issues.suggestion: Fix the i18n binding so the correct translated string is rendered instead of the key identifier

issues.description: The third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, truncating its name and hiding delivery info
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll/padding or card width so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability without abrupt clipping

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon has inconsistent background styling between the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card (white background) and the pizza promo card (dark background), creating visual inconsistency
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button style (background color/opacity) across all promotional and restaurant cards
